meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 收到重构请求后，先确认目标与范围，再梳理代码依赖与测试覆盖，制定计划，逐步修改并在每步后运行测试验证，最后跑完整测试、类型检查、代码检查和构建。
howto.when: 当你说出“refactor”“refactoring”“cleanup”等触发词，或要求重构、清理、简化代码时触发；目标不明确时它会先提问。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 里的验证逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: 它会先理清依赖和测试，再分步重构。

say.text: 重构 AuthService 类，改成更简洁的写法
say.note: 目标明确时直接进入分析与计划流程。

say.text: 帮我清理项目里所有用过时 API 的代码
say.note: 若范围模糊，它会先问清楚期望结果。

howto.what_en: On a refactor request, Claude confirms the goal and scope, maps dependencies and test coverage, creates a plan, applies changes step by step, and runs tests after each step. It finishes with the full test suite, type check, lint, and build checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered by user saying refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize or by a request to refactor, clean up or simplify code. If the target is vague, Claude asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: It maps dependencies and tests, then refactors step by step.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class to a simpler design.
say_en.note: A clear target lets it proceed straight to planning.

say_en.text: Help me clean up all code using deprecated APIs in the project.
say_en.note: If scope is vague, it will ask what you want first.
